```{=html}
<button class="theme-toggle" onclick="toggleTheme()" id="themeBtn">☀ Light</button>
<script>
const prefersDark = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
const saved = localStorage.getItem('theme');
const theme = saved || (prefersDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);
updateBtn(theme);
function toggleTheme() {
  const current = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme');
  const next = current === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
  document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', next);
  localStorage.setItem('theme', next);
  updateBtn(next);
}
function updateBtn(theme) {
  const btn = document.getElementById('themeBtn');
  if (btn) btn.textContent = theme === 'dark' ? '☀ Light' : '☾ Dark';
}
</script>
```

## About Me

I am **Moses Martin Njuguna Gikonyo**, a Data Scientist and Quantitative Financial Engineer based in Nairobi, Kenya. I specialise in applied machine learning, data visualisation, and quantitative finance, with a strong foundation in both R and Python.

I completed my **Applied Data Science** programme and am commencing my **MSc in Financial Engineering at WorldQuant University** in April 2026, further deepening my expertise in quantitative methods and financial modelling.

My current work focuses on building a **frontier market regime classification framework**, with a live node operating in Baku — applying cutting-edge machine learning techniques to emerging and frontier market intelligence.

## My Data Science Journey

I launched this site in **2021** as a resource for those beginning their journey in R and data science. What started as a personal learning log has grown into a platform reflecting years of hands-on experience across industries.

My technical toolkit includes **R & R Markdown, Python, Machine Learning, and Data Visualization** — applied across projects ranging from churn analytics and customer lifetime value platforms to Bayesian causal inference and A/B experimentation frameworks.

If you are new to R, explore my introductory content — built from the ground up with beginners in mind.
